{{Quote|I sent the omega alert. Only half our field agents responded. I'm telling you, we're compromised!|Special Agent Tander|<ref name="Search">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Search for Agent Galen|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
An '''omega alert''', also known as '''alert level omega''', was a code broadcast by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence agency, that ordered all active agents to immediately respond, regardless of their current activities. [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] [[Korol Tander]] sent an omega alert on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] when he believed that their operations had been compromised by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the Empire, and he was alarmed to receive responses from only half of the active agents.<ref name="Search" />

==Behind the scenes==
The omega alert was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "The Search for Agent Galen" on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="Search" />
